main: user-designated prior B2: source-free, ABS+DELTA+RATIO, no ZDELTA, no beta/low-gamma/high-gamma DELTA mean/std
selection_context: user requested after viewing previous Development outcomes; exploratory adaptive follow-up, not blind confirmation
derive: authoritative manifest -> prior B2 retained36 -> select ONE view; never restore any removed spectral DELTA coordinate
preprocessing: unchanged original full88D Patient Z plus FIT-only imputer/scaler; gather canonical retained inputs afterwards
normalization: same multiplicity-aware original88-position LN statistics with removed positions zero, epsilon1e-5; not native LN(k)
architecture: Linear(k,96), GELU, Dropout0.15, Linear(96,1); no source head
initialization: independent scratch training; fold original seeded untrained A0 initialization for each view; never fine-tune main checkpoint
main_reuse: five frozen prior B2 checkpoints and validation predictions hash-verified; no main retraining

training.selection: own validation Macro-F1, EZ-F1 tie, earlier epoch

stop: three single-view arms only; no combinations, rescue, new seed, global subset, outer TEST or result-driven threshold changes
publish: source, hashes, anonymous aggregate metrics only; no identities, raw features, individual predictions, weights or logs
